findings.message: The publication guard does not authenticate the owner lock, while finally releases self._lock dynamically after the generation swap. A before_publish callback replacing _lock with a fresh unlocked threading.Lock passes all guards, publishes the new generation, then raises release-unlocked-lock and strands the originally acquired lock.
findings.required_correction: Capture and authenticate the exact acquired primitive lock across callbacks/publication; release only the captured lock. Add a mutation regression proving unchanged accepted state/history/epoch and safe original-lock release.

findings.message: The function/source-file guard does not bind mutable U/SHIFT globals. For a BASE/CM0 owner, mutating imported SHIFT in the pose callback changes the frozen common-motion shift consumed by _targets, but expand(BASE), function fingerprints and source-file hashes remain unchanged. Imported participating ElasticSection/Reference class methods are also outside the declared dispatch module traversal and need coverage assessment.
findings.required_correction: Own and authenticate all selected transform authority and complete participating runtime dispatch, including imported native section/reference operations. Add mutation regressions that fail before publication and retain poisoned-owner semantics.

scope.acceptance_boundary: Read-only initial mixed-owner implementation review; no reviewer mechanics execution and no acceptance of graph implementation, qualification, recovery, restart or defaults.
